kCAFG_accept_steward_promotion_suggestions_again = {
	category = interaction_category_vassal
	use_diplomatic_range = no
	ignores_pending_interaction_block = yes
	interface_priority = 50
	icon = council

	is_shown = {
        scope:actor = { has_variable = kCAFG_ignore_steward_promotion_suggestions }
		scope:recipient = {
            is_councillor_of = scope:actor
            is_performing_council_task = task_promote_culture
        }
	}

	on_accept = {
        custom_tooltip = kCAFG_accept_steward_promotion_suggestions_again_effect
        hidden_effect = { scope:actor = { remove_variable = kCAFG_ignore_steward_promotion_suggestions } }
	}

	ai_accept = {
		base = 100
	}
	
	auto_accept = yes
}
